integrity: Mathematical proof and local consistency tests supplied; unpublished or unindexed prior coverage not exhausted. The Frobenius eigenvalue proof is independent of finite experiments.
scientific_limitations: The claimed zeta applies to the Waldron--Witaszek model over F_128; universal-homeomorphism comparison concerns prime-to-two etale cohomology, not coherent/Hodge cohomology. Chow equivalence is rational and no integral torsion statement follows. Earlier zeta calculations for the corresponding smooth cubic are not claimed as new.
title: The irregular characteristic-two Fano fourfold has a cubic-fourfold zeta function
